model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира сравнение на масивни активации и феномени на „attention sink" при различни конфигурации на гейтинг, като съдържа две ясно видими линейни диаграми в долната част на изображението, придружени от множество визуализации (топлинни карти) в горната част, които обаче са силно избледнели и трудно различими.

Лявата линейна диаграма има ос X, обозначена като „Layer", с линейна скала, обхващаща диапазон от 0 до приблизително 20–25, с етикети при стойности 0, 5, 10, 15 и 20. Оста Y е обозначена като „Max" и обхваща диапазон от 0 до 400, с етикети при 0, 200 и 400. В графиката се наблюдават няколко линии с различни цветове. Синя линия (плътна) остава близо до нулата в началните слоеве и показва рязък връх около слой 15–17, достигайки стойности в диапазона около 300–400, след което спада. Зелена линия (пунктирана) също остава ниска в началото и показва по-умерен връх около слой 15–20, достигайки стойности приблизително около 100–200. Червена линия се наблюдава с по-малък връх около слой 10–12. Останалите линии остават относително ниски и близо до нулата през по-голямата част от диапазона на слоевете.

Дясната линейна диаграма има ос X, обозначена като „layer", с линейна скала от 0 до приблизително 20, с етикети при 0, 5, 10, 15 и 20. Оста Y е обозначена като „first ratio" и обхваща диапазон от 0.0 до приблизително 0.2–0.4, с етикети при 0.0 и 0.2. В тази графика синя линия (плътна) показва рязко покачване в ранните слоеве (около слой 5–6), достигайки стойност приблизително 0.3–0.4, и остава на високо ниво за останалите слоеве. Зелена линия (пунктирана) остава близо до нулата през целия диапазон на слоевете. Червена линия също остава на ниски стойности, близо до нулата, през по-голямата част от диапазона, с възможно леко покачване в по-късните слоеве.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The figure presents a comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations, with two line charts visible at the bottom of the figure.

Both charts share the same x-axis, labeled "Layer" (left chart) or "layer" (right chart), displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The left chart's y-axis is labeled "max" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 400, with tick marks at 0, 200, and 400. The right chart's y-axis is labeled "first ratio" on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.4, with tick marks at 0.0, 0.2, and a value near 0.4.

In the left chart, there are multiple colored lines. A blue line remains near 0 for layers 0 through roughly 5, then rises sharply around layer 6 to a peak near 400, drops back down, and shows another spike around layer 15–17 before declining. A green line stays relatively low and flat across most layers, with modest fluctuations remaining below approximately 50. A red line similarly remains low across most layers with a small spike visible around layer 15. A dashed line (appearing brown or orange) stays near zero throughout.

In the right chart, a blue line starts near 0.0 for the first several layers, then rises sharply around layer 5–6 to approximately 0.3–0.4, and remains elevated at that level through layer 22. A green line remains near 0.0 across all layers. A red line also stays near 0.0 for most layers but shows a slight elevation beginning around layer 5–6, remaining at a very low value. A dashed line stays near 0.0 throughout all layers.
model_annotations.English:
This figure presents a comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations, as described in the caption. The visible portion of the figure includes two line plots at the bottom.

The left plot has an x-axis labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled "max" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 400, with tick marks at 0, 200, and 400. Multiple lines are shown in different colors. A blue solid line remains near zero from layer 0 through approximately layer 5, then rises sharply to a peak of roughly 400 around layer 6–7, before declining and showing additional fluctuations around layers 13–17. A green dashed line remains relatively flat and close to zero across all layers. A red line (possibly dotted or dash-dotted) also remains near zero for most layers but shows a small spike around layer 13–15, reaching approximately 50–100. Additional lines in other styles appear to overlap near the baseline or show modest variations.

The right plot has an x-axis labeled "layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at 0, 5, 10, and 15, 20. The y-axis is labeled "first ratio" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.3 or slightly above, with tick marks at 0.0 and 0.2. A blue solid line starts near zero at layer 0, remains near zero until approximately layer 5–6, then rises sharply to a value of roughly 0.3 around layer 7, and remains elevated at approximately that level through layer 22. A green dashed line remains near zero across all layers. A red line also remains near zero throughout the layer range. Additional lines appear to stay close to zero or show minimal variation.
model_annotations.German:
Diese Abbildung (Figure 6) vergleicht massive Aktivierungen und Attention-Sink-Phänomene über verschiedene Gating-Konfigurationen hinweg. Die beiden sichtbaren Liniendiagramme am unteren Rand der Abbildung teilen eine ähnliche Achsenstruktur. Das linke Diagramm hat eine x-Achse mit der Beschriftung „Layer", die linear skaliert ist und von 0 bis etwa 23 reicht, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 5, 10, 15 und 20. Die y-Achse ist mit „Max" beschriftet und reicht linear von 0 bis etwa 400, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 200 und 400. Das rechte Diagramm hat eine x-Achse mit der Beschriftung „layer", ebenfalls linear skaliert von 0 bis etwa 23 mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 5, 10, 15 und 20. Die y-Achse ist mit „first ratio" beschriftet und reicht von 0.0 bis etwa 0.4, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0.0 und 0.2.

Im linken Diagramm sind mehrere Linien in unterschiedlichen Farben dargestellt. Eine blaue durchgezogene Linie verläuft nahe null für die ersten Layer und zeigt dann einen starken Anstieg ab etwa Layer 6, mit einem markanten Spitzenwert von ungefähr 400 bei Layer 20–22. Eine grüne Linie (gestrichelt oder durchgezogen) bleibt über den gesamten Layerbereich relativ niedrig nahe null, mit nur geringfügigen Schwankungen. Eine rote Linie zeigt ebenfalls niedrige Werte über die meisten Layer hinweg, weist jedoch einen kleinen Ausschlag bei etwa Layer 14–16 auf, der Werte von ungefähr 50–100 erreicht, bevor sie wieder abfällt. Eine weitere braune oder dunkelrote gestrichelte Linie verläuft ähnlich wie die blaue Linie mit einem Anstieg in den späteren Layern.

Im rechten Diagramm zeigt eine blaue durchgezogene Linie einen abrupten Anstieg von nahe 0.0 bei den ersten Layern auf etwa 0.3–0.4 ab ungefähr Layer 5–6, und bleibt dann auf diesem erhöhten Niveau für die restlichen Layer bis Layer 22 relativ konstant. Eine grüne Linie bleibt über den gesamten Layerbereich nahe 0.0 ohne erkennbaren Anstieg. Eine rote Linie verläuft ebenfalls nahe 0.0 über alle Layer, zeigt jedoch möglicherweise einen leichten Anstieg in den mittleren Layern.
